column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister's Friends Won't Help
After school, I immediately brought Kirino to the Akihabara station.
I'm not sure if we're early, but Saori and Kuroneko are nowhere to be seen.
Heh～, so this is Akihabara.
This girl, she's looking around as if this is her first time here.
Come to think of it... this was also where we met Kuroneko and Saori for the first time.
Ooh, somehow it feels like things will go smoothly...
Uwah, there are so many people just like you in groups～
...Or not.
Will everything go smoothly as it is?
Uwah! Isn't that person overdoing it? It's already out of fashion to be carrying a rucksack, and there's some rod-like thing sticking out of it...
Actually, only a minority of otaku dress in that style. But because it's rare, seeing it leaves a very strong impact.
Yeah, even I think it's too much...
Kiririn-shi! Kyousuke-shi! Over here!
Wait, Saori?!
H-Hey... Don't tell me the duo you were telling me about..?
...Yes, the big one is Saori, and the black one is Kuroneko. They're your friends.
Ick...
Well, it's normal to be shocked.
I did cough out the water I was drinking when we first met too...
Well, well, Kyousuke-shi. The situation this time seems quite serious, 'tis not?
Yeah, now I can't help but think that you were born under the star of calamity.
Sorry about that, you two. For making you specially come out here.
Which reminds me, Saori's house is located pretty far away.
And yet, she agreed to meet up once I contacted her. I really am no match for her.
But... the important person here, Kirino, was like this, huh?
...Right, this is a dream... A bad dream...
Hey Kirino, snap back into reality.
...Uhh.
This Kirino... she's actually looking at Saori and Kuroneko as if they were some rare species.
S-Say, Saori... Right now, Kirino...
Hahaha, you don't have to finish saying it, I fully understand, Kyousuke-shi.
...Saori.
Well then, first I'll introduce myself to Kiririn-shi. I am Saori Bageena. Would it be better if I say 'Nice to meet you'?
And this person is...
Hmph, it's not necessary to give out my name. I'm sure she has heard of my name just now.
D-Don't say that, I'm sure you understand what's going on about Kirino from Saori, right?
...It can't be helped if "Nii-san" puts it this way.
Nii-san～?
H-Hey! You, that was on purpose, wasn't it?!
My name is Kuroneko. You should carve my name onto your tiny soul, so as never to forget about it again.
Huh?
Uwah?! Without delay, Kirino had broken into her displeased mode caused by Kuroneko's way of speech!
Hey you. could you stop the nonsense you've been spouting since the start?
Hmph... At least her mouth is still the same.
In that case, could you also stop putting on that remarkable fashionista style of yours? Akiba is the wrong place for that, you're an eyesore.
W-What are you saying?! This is this year's fashionable...!
What's with this... Based on this back-and-forth argument, isn't it the same as before...?
Now, now, you two. This isn't the place to have a lover's quarrel. How about we promptly go to the maid cafe we frequent?
C-Come on, Saori also said it, so have a little self-control here, okay? Let's hurry to the maid cafe.
I'm... not going...
H-Hey Kirino, what are you saying? Everybody gathered here just for the sake of recovering your memories, there's no meaning if you're not around!
But isn't a maid cafe a place where gross otakus go and gather in to see the waitresses dressed up in maid costumes?
How could I go... to such a place?
Kiririn-shi...
It doesn't matter if you don't wish to come. Shall we go, "Nii-san"?
Don't decide that on your own! I don't want to walk together with such disgusting otakus!
And also, I'll say this now since there's a chance, but do you two know how prominent you are?
To put it across clearly, I don't believe we're friends. It's a bad joke, right?
H-Hey... she can't joke about what she has just said.
Saori's spirits are obviously down, and Kuroneko's eyes are also a little wet.
Hey, stop it, Kirino. These two are here today for your sake.
It's not like I asked them to. Rather, could you tell me in advance if we're meeting people like this?
Tch... This girl, is she still being stubborn?
A-Anyway, it'll be bad at this rate if I don't follow up and revert the situation!
S-Say, Saori. Kirino is currently...
...I understand, Kyousuke-shi.
You understand... what exactly?
W-What's wrong? What's with that strange exchanging of looks... Rather, w-why did the two of them smile so suddenly?
W-What's so funny?
Funny? Right, everything about you is just simply laughable.
...Huh?
You said you've lost your memories? If you're going to lie, you'll need to come up with something better than that.
You're just like a kid that would bandage her own wrist for no reason. You just want others to make you feel special, and worry for you. That's why you
came up with this kind of setting for your own wilfulness, right?
Haha, a splendid Chuunibyou.
What are the two of you saying?! I'm being serious...
Thou need not feel embarrassed, Kiririn-shi. 'Tis something anyone can get, just like measles.
Yes, I know your feelings like the palm of my hand. It can't be just "anyone", right?
There's only one person you wish to turn and look at you... That must be your elder brother that you just love too much, right?
W-Wha...?!
Ooooooh?! I recognize this atmosphere.
Earthquakes, thunderstorms, fires, little sisters, before any natural disaster like those happens, everything will stop like this, and then...
W-W-W-W-W-Who would love this kind of a guy?! You Jakigan Chuunibyou girl-----------!
C-C-C-C-Control yourself, Kirino----!
Let me go! I'm going to kill her!
H-Hey, don't say something so dangerous in front of the station! H-Hey, don't struggle! Don't elbow me!
Babbling nonsense just when I decide to listen for a while, who's a Chuunibyou?! Who's a kid?!
That all clearly describes you! Even though you're a damn wannabe writer that can only write self-satisfying Jakigan novels!
Y-You... just completely stepped on a landmine for Kuroneko.
Even if your own book got published, that's too much...
...Wait, hey. How did you know about Kuroneko's ambition to be a novelist?
Eh? Ah...
It's true that I've showed Kirino the novel Kuroneko wrote. However, I didn't tell her if it was a professional novel or an amateur doujin story.
Even if I explained, Kirino wouldn't have understood since she doesn't have otaku knowledge.
Which means...
M-My... memories... have returned...?
S-S-S-S...
Success-------!
D-Don't hug my head! Ahhh, enough, let me go!
Oh my? So you really did lose your memories? I really thought you had measles.
A setting like memory loss is something only shallow-minded humans could have thought up.
L-Like I said, don't put me together with your Jakigan nonsense!
Kirino and Kuroneko started a lover's quarrel.
This is quite a common spectacle, but it's been a long time since then, so I just...
Eh, Kyousuke-shi? Are you crying?
S-Shut up!
These are tears accumulated from fatigue and stress!
Damn, that Saori... She smiled mischievously like she saw through everything...
Eh... Saw through everything?
...By any chance, were you both putting up an act just to anger Kirino...?
Eh, I really don't know what you're talking about...
Then don't put a ':3' face and start whistling away.
Hey, are you seriously saying that?
T-Then how else could I have put it!
...The one saying this isn't the true Kirino.
Huh? What's with this about the real me?
Yeah, I get it. To the current Kirino, that phrase is forbidden as it denies her existence.
Nevertheless, I couldn't keep it in.
My little sister is someone with a cheeky and extremely irritating personality, she calmly tells people to die, but...
...Even so, she's not a person that will hurt her friends.
That's why... the current you isn't my little sister. Even if Dad or Mom acknowledges you, I won't acknowledge you.
I yelled as my emotions overflowed.
Kirino's face went pale and didn't move as if time had stopped.
Hmph, I'm don't care anymore.
Kuroneko, Saori. I'm really sorry for asking you both to accompany me today. I'll treat you both at the maid cafe.
Kyousuke-shi...
Is this all right?
...There's no problem, let's go.
Both of them were confused, looking from Kirino to me, but eventually they started walking behind me.
For an instant, I saw Kirino with her her eyes cast down at the corner of my vision. However, I don't intend to stop.
In the end, Kirino didn't come to the maid cafe.
Is that how the current... How the 'new you' really feels?
D-Do you have a problem with it?
Damn it, isn't this exactly the same as three days ago?
In other words, there's no turning back from the catastrophe here due to her dishonest personality, right?
Good grief, what should I do now?
Somehow, I need to let them know that what she just said isn't her true feelings.
...Of course we have a problem with it. Just what do you think of us?
Kuroneko?!
What? Didn't I say I think of you guys as disgusting otakus?
Disgusting... Huh. Then, I wonder if you could explain which part is "disgusting"?
H-Huh? What are you saying? I'll say it's disgusting if I feel that it is!
I see. You define everything outside of your sense of aesthetics as "disgusting". It's an opinion quite like that of a brainless troll on the internet.
Wha-?!
By that definition, your appearance is "disgusting" in my eyes. Quickly undress or just get out of my sight, why don't you?
Y...You are one to talk! Take off that sultry black dress right now?! It makes me feel hot to the point of death just by looking at you!
Hmph, you said the same thing the first time we met. Not only is your vocabulary, even your thinking is lacking.
Gggmmmmnnnnnggghhh!!
Oooh, that's Kuroneko for you. She has been researching on how to point out Kirino's faults during this past year.
...However, I don't dislike that part of you.
It's quite stimulating to quarrel with you, and most of all it's very enjoyable to see you flip out.
Wha... Wha...
Kuroneko... You...
It looks your true nature hasn't changed despite losing your memories... Very well. I will acknowledge you.
...It's just as she said. I understood after looking at the two of you arguing.
The you that doesn't acknowledge otakus is still you. You've just broken the shell known as your self and changed yourself...
Kiririn-shi didn't change at all. She's still our friend.
You two...
Tch... I'm not happy about being acknowledged by otakus.
Kirino... You can't hide your smile, just as usual.
However... That's right. Even if she were to forget about her otaku interests, Kirino is still Kirino. My little sister.
